{{Quote|Somebody's taught the Ewoks the ''Starfarer's Return'', and they want me to dance.|Lieutenant [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''''Starfarer's Return''''' was a song. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were taught this song by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and played it during the celebration of their victory. Alliance [[Assistant Historian]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] later recalled dancing to the song during that celebration.
